body:
Hello! We're Jalapenos and we're back after our 2 month hiatus and we're looking to rebuild our team with new and old members.
Anyone who was on the team before we disbanded gets invited without having to apply.

We scrim anytime from around 4pm GMT to 10pm GMT. We are mainly looking for all-rounders.
